intro: Prabhuva Nee Karyamulu is a famous Telugu Christian song from the album, Chirakaala Sneham released in 2008 approx., written, tuned by Lillian Christopher and sung by Telugu Christian Gospel Singers Trio, Sharon Sisters and music composed by renowned Telugu Christian music director, J K Christopher.
